_meta.source: Department of Health Consolidated Salary Scales, 1 June 2026 (read with DoH Circular 2/2026)
_meta.section: Medical & Dental Grades, pp 5-7 of the PDF
_meta.figures_are: annual basic salary per incremental point
notes: Two effective-date rows per grade: 1/6/26 is current; 1/2/26 is the prior rate (kept so shifts before 1 June 2026 can be priced correctly).
'FOR PENSION PURPOSES' duplicate rows (retirees before 1 July 2017) are deliberately excluded - they are not pay scales for serving NCHDs.
Weekly rate = annual / 52.18 (stated in the Guide to the Scales inside the PDF).
Basic hourly for NCHDs = weekly / 39 (39-hour basic week under the NCHD contract) - CONFIRM this divisor against the NCHD contract before shipping; some grades elsewhere in the HSE use 37.5.
Verify every figure against the PDF before release - this was hand-transcribed from the extracted text.

grades.note: Payment may also be made for up to 5 days induction, pro rata if shorter.
